market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.2m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela production hit 1,095 tb/d in March 2026, growing month-over-month. April exports at 1.23m suggest similar production levels. With Repsol joint venture and Chevron license, output trajectory is up. Hitting 1,200 tb/d in any of remaining 8+ months looks more likely than not.
